Flaming Fist Healers are Clerics of the Flaming Fist. They are commonly found in Baldur's Gate in Act Three.
“
You're not alone, sir. We're here with you. And I'm sure you've got relations, maybe some long-lived friends, even, who'll want to be seeing you.
„
— J'ehlar, to unconscious Art Cullagh
